primary_gt.required_interpretation: combined hourly-burst plus larger storm-total accumulation diagnosis

event.event_name: Post-Tropical Cyclone Ida NYC flash flood

criteria.name: Compact numeric response
criteria.description: Provides the requested compact JSON fields, correct event window, and final label.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for a mostly correct structure with one or two missing fields.

criteria.name: Rainfall unit conversions
criteria.description: Correctly converts 3.47 inches to 88.138 mm and 10.0 inches to 254.0 mm with appropriate units.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for using the correct conversion but rounding poorly or omitting one unit.

criteria.name: Partition arithmetic
criteria.description: Correctly computes the partition ratio 0.347 and residual 165.862 mm.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 1.5 points for one correct value or a correct formula with arithmetic error.

criteria.name: Gridded precipitation comparison
criteria.description: Correctly identifies the gridded maximum as 136.888 mm and computes its regional ratio as 0.539.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 1.5 points for using a valid product value but missing the maximum or ratio.

criteria.name: Inequality reasoning
criteria.description: Interprets 88.138 < 136.888 < 254.0, city-hour share below 1, and residual above 0 consistently.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 1.5 points for one correct inequality without the full partition logic.

criteria.name: Single-measure rejection
criteria.description: Explains that neither the record hour nor the regional total alone captures the computed diagnosis.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for rejecting only one single-measure substitution.

criteria.name: Calculation-bound interpretation
criteria.description: Keeps the interpretation concise and tied to the computed rainfall metrics.
criteria.partial_credit: Award no credit if the answer mainly becomes a broad narrative.

provenance.notes: All values are computed or extracted from local CSX-071 rainfall records.
